title: Google Workspace License Weekly Days Unused Trend
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=googleworkspace:license days_unused=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_unused) as avg_duration, max(days_unused) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days unused for Google Workspace license events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_unused on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days unused with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether Google Workspace license tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
